component.name: NineSQL
component.summary: Native database client for SQL engines

description.p: NineSQL is an open-source database client for the Linux desktop, written in Rust with a GPU-rendered interface. It connects to PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQLite and wire-compatible engines (TimescaleDB, YugabyteDB, QuestDB, TiDB), and imports DBeaver workspaces without modifying them.

ul.li: SQL editor with completion, parameters and script runs
Results grid that streams large results within a memory budget
Database navigator, object editor and DDL
Data editing with a preview of the statements, export and CSV import
Read-only connections enforced by the database session, and confirmations on production
Passwords kept in an encrypted vault or the desktop keyring, never in plain files
Verified TLS and SSH tunnels with host key checks

description.p: NineSQL sends no telemetry and connects only to the databases you declare and their SSH hops.
